statement.name: GetThemesData
statement.sql:
SELECT PFMBD.TASVersionCode as ThemeVersion, ExtSys.DimensionValue as BaseURL, REPLACE(pcp.RelativeUrl, '{0}', CAST(ExtSys.DimensionValue as varchar(200))) as AbsoluteUrl FROM PFM_TASVersionConfig PFMBD INNER JOIN LU_PFM_Version PFMVersion on PFMVersion.LookupCode = PFMBD.CoreVersionCode INNER JOIN PFM_CORE_PreDefinedPage PCP on PCP.COREPreDefinedPageId = PFMBD.COREPreDefinedPageId INNER JOIN ExternalSystemDimensionValue ExtSys on ExtSys.ExternalSystemCode = PCP.ExternalSystemCode AND ExtSys.ExternalSystemDimensionCode = PCP.ExternalSystemDimensionCode
203

statement.name: GetScriptsData
statement.sql:
SELECT PFMBD.TASVersionCode as ScriptVersion, ExtSys.DimensionValue as BaseURL, REPLACE(pcp.RelativeUrl, '{0}', CAST(ExtSys.DimensionValue as varchar(200))) as AbsoluteUrl FROM PFM_TASVersionConfig PFMBD INNER JOIN LU_PFM_Version PFMVersion on PFMVersion.LookupCode = PFMBD.CoreVersionCode INNER JOIN PFM_CORE_PreDefinedPage PCP on PCP.COREPreDefinedPageId = PFMBD.COREPreDefinedPageId INNER JOIN ExternalSystemDimensionValue ExtSys on ExtSys.ExternalSystemCode = PCP.ExternalSystemCode AND ExtSys.ExternalSystemDimensionCode = PCP.ExternalSystemDimensionCode
204
